source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: قررنا نطلع عالجبل نتمشى بيوم عطلة.
sentences.en: We decided to climb the mountain to hike on a day off.

sentences.ar: حملنا مي وأكل ولبسنا كنادر مريحة.
sentences.en: We carried water and food and wore comfortable shoes.

sentences.ar: الطلعة كانت صعبة والجو كان بارد.
sentences.en: The climb was hard and the weather was cold.

sentences.ar: بس المنظر من فوق كان بيوخذ العقل.
sentences.en: But the view from the top was breathtaking.
We saw the small villages and the green trees.
We sat on a big rock, ate, and rested.
The air was fresh and the world was quiet.
Before sunset, we started going down home.
We came back tired but full of energy.
